. This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard Mr. Nirakar Jena, learned counsel for the petitioner appears through Virtual High Court at Bhadrak and Mr. Priyabrata Tripathy, learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State of Odisha.

This is an application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Special POCSO Case No.04 of 2023 arising out of Pirahat P.S. Case No.188 of 2022 pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge -cum- Special Court under POCSO Act, Bhadrak for offences punishable under sections 363/366/ 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and section 6 of the POCSO Act.
// 2 // The prayer for bail of the petitioner was rejected by the learned Additional Sessions Judge -cum- Special Court under POCSO Act, Bhadrak vide order dated 25.01.2023.

Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is in judicial custody since 14.11.2022 and he has been charge sheeted under sections 363/366/376(2)(n)
of the Indian Penal Code and section 6 of the POCSO Act and after going through the statement of the victim, which is annexed to the bail application and on hearing the learned counsel for the State,
I am inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
